title: MonitorDefaultDTO
description: MonitorDefaultDTO schema from Monitor Plan Management OpenAPI Specification

parameterCode.description: Code used to identify the parameter.

defaultValue.description: Value of default, maximum, minimum or constant.

defaultUnitsOfMeasureCode.description: Code used to identify the hourly parameter units of measure.

defaultPurposeCode.description: Code used to identify the purpose or intended use of defaults, maximums and constants.

fuelCode.description: Code used to identify the type of fuel.

operatingConditionCode.description: Code used to identify the operating condition.

defaultSourceCode.description: Code used to identify the source of the default value.

groupId.description: For a group of identical LME units using testing to determine default NOx rate, this ID identifies the group.

beginDate.description: Date on which information became effective or activity started.

beginHour.description: Hour in which information became effective.

endDate.description: Last date in which information was effective.  This date will be null for active records.

endHour.description: Last hour in which information was effective.  This value will be null for active records.

id.description: Unique identifier of a monitoring default record.

locationId.description: Unique identifier of a monitoring location record.

userId.description: User account or source of data that added or updated record.

addDate.description: Date and time in which record was added.

updateDate.description: Date and time in which record was last updated.

active.description: Flag for active monitor location record
